rows.label: dog
rows.description: domesticated mammal of the family Canidae
rows.hook: is called man's best friend and was the first animal humans domesticated

rows.label: axolotl
rows.hook: is a Mexican salamander famous for regrowing lost limbs and keeping its larval gills for life

rows.label: chicken
rows.description: domesticated bird (specifically a red junglefowl) kept by humans primarily as a food source
rows.hook: is the farmyard bird kept worldwide for its eggs and meat, and is descended from a jungle bird of Asia

rows.label: maize
rows.description: species of grass cultivated as a food crop
rows.hook: is the tall cereal crop that gives us corn on the cob, popcorn and tortillas

rows.label: guinea pig
rows.hook: is a South American rodent kept as a popular pet and long used in laboratory experiments

rows.label: Drosophila melanogaster
rows.hook: is the tiny fruit fly that geneticists have used for over a century to study heredity

rows.label: Escherichia coli
rows.hook: is a gut bacterium studied in countless labs, and some strains cause food poisoning

rows.label: brown rat
rows.hook: is the common sewer-dwelling rodent that spread across the world in ships, and is a lab staple

rows.label: house mouse
rows.hook: is the small whiskered rodent that lives in our homes and is the most common lab animal for medical research

rows.label: Pisum sativum
rows.description: species of plant with edible seeds
rows.hook: is the green legume whose seeds Gregor Mendel crossed to discover the laws of inheritance

rows.label: rhesus macaque
rows.hook: is a monkey that lent its name to a blood-group factor and has been widely used in medical research

rows.label: Saccharomyces cerevisiae
rows.hook: is the microscopic fungus used for baking bread and brewing beer
